item.title: Hegemony: Kerala’s Bharatapuzha as a political stage
item.description: Unlike the North Indian Kumbh, the Bharatapuzha by contrast has never functioned as a Pan-Hindu pilgrimage centre. It has no historical association with mass ritual bathing, no priestly networks that regulate sacred time, and no inherited mythological mandate that binds the river to cyclical purification rites. The introduction of the Maha Magha Mahotsavam is a clear cultural imposition by Hindutva The post Hegemony: Kerala’s Bharatapuzha as a political stage appeared first on SabrangIndia.
